item.title: Winter Storm Picture Becomes Clearer
item.description: A Winter Storm Watch is now in effect for much of northern South Carolina, including the Upstate, Catawba Region, the northern Midlands and northern Pee Dee.

item.title: Sullivan's Island Public Safety Provides Winter Weather Advisory Update
item.description: As of 1:20 AM this morning, the NWS expanded its winter weather advisory to include tidal Berkeley and Charleston counties. Freezing drizzle is possible in trace amounts. Please use caution if you must drive, particularly on bridges and overpasses.

item.title: IOP Recreation Department’s Free Sea Stroll & Learn Offers Exciting Lineup for 2026
item.description: The City of Isle of Palms Recreation Department will host the fourth annual Sea Stroll & Learn series from May through November on the second Thursday of each month at 7:30 a.m.

item.title: Charleston Symphony Orchestra League to Host Prelude Luncheon With Artist Mary Whyte
item.description: The Charleston Symphony Orchestra League will host a Prelude Luncheon featuring renowned folk artist Mary Whyte on Tuesday, March 3, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Gibbes Museum of Art.

item.title: Local Students Make Furman University Fall 2025 Dean’s List
item.description: The following Furman University students from the area were named to the dean’s list for the Fall 2025 semester. The dean’s list recognizes full-time undergraduate students who earn a grade point average of 3.4 or higher on a 4.0 scale.

item.title: SC250 Seeks Approval to Build Replica Palmetto Log Fort on Sullivan’s Island

item.title: Mount Pleasant’s Jason Annan Takes First at Charlie Post Classic 15K
item.description: The annual Charlie Post Classic 15K Run, 5K Run and 5K Walk were held on Sullivan’s Island on Saturday, Jan. 24. The 15K race was won by Mount Pleasant resident Jason Annan, who finished with a time of 55:52.105.

item.title: Isle of Palms Fire Department Receives Fire Safe SC Designation
item.description: The City of Isle of Palms Fire Department has earned the Fire Safe SC designation for another year, recognizing the department’s commitment to fire prevention, public safety education and emergency preparedness.

item.title: Isle of Palms Recreation Department to Host Community Yard Sale
item.description: The Isle of Palms Recreation Department will host its annual Community Yard Sale on Saturday, March 21, from 8 to 11 a.m. at the Isle of Palms Recreation Center.

item.title: 2026 Isle of Palms Polar Plunge Set for Feb. 28 at The Windjammer
item.description: The 2026 Isle of Palms Polar Plunge benefiting Special Olympics South Carolina will take place Saturday, Feb. 28, from 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. at The Windjammer, located at 1008 Ocean Blvd.
